title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Following a sustained period of strategic and planned growth, our market-leading client in Coventry is now seeking an ambitious and proactive Accounts Assistant to join their dynamic finance team. Known for being forward-thinking and continuously striving for excellence, this prestigious firm consistently proves why they are a dominant force in their sector-making this an outstanding, high-value addition to any CV.

Working closely within a highly supportive and collaborative team, you will enjoy a broad, varied, and engaging remit. This role is vital in ensuring the smooth operation of the finance department, particularly during critical reporting periods.

What We Are Looking For:
- Exceptional Communication Skills, professional verbal and written communication to confidently liaise and build rapport with both internal teams and external stakeholders.
- Resilience approach under pressure, with the proven ability to multi-task and meet tight deadlines during busy month-end periods.
- Exceptionally well-organised with a sharp eye for detail, ensuring flawless data entry and financial reporting.
- A strong, practical knowledge of Microsoft Excel (especially pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, and data manipulation).

What's in it for You?
- Join a business that genuinely values its workforce, actively investing in the professional growth, mentorship, and career progression of their team.
- Step into a positive, welcoming, and inclusive workplace where collaborative teamwork is celebrated.
- Work from a contemporary, state-of-the-art office space in Coventry that boasts an easy commute and hassle-free, on-site parking.
- Enjoy the flexibility of a modern working model with hybrid work options and flexible start and finish times, allowing you to balance a high-performing career with your personal life.

If you are a driven and motivated finance professional looking to elevate your skills and CV in a thriving company, we want to hear from you. Apply today and send us your CV

title: Assistant Management Accountant
description:
Location: Coventry (office based)

Salary: £32-34k

3 Point Recruitment are partnering with an award winning and ambitious Coventry based SME to recruit an Assistant Management Accountant - a key hire needed ASAP!

This is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious, personable & confident finance professional who is ready to take the next step in their career. You'll gain hands on exposure across the full month end cycle, work closely with an experienced Financial Controller and play a vital role in shaping the finance function as this ambitious SME continues to grow.

Duties Will Include
- Support the preparation of monthly management accounts, including key journals and reconciliations
- Complete balance sheet reconciliations across accruals, prepayments, fixed assets, stock and bank
- Assist with P&L reviews, variance analysis and monthly KPI reporting
- Maintain and update the general ledger, ensuring accuracy across all postings
- Oversee AP/AR activity and resolve queries to support smooth financial operations
- Manage banking and cashflow tasks, including daily reconciliations and cash reporting
- Maintain the fixed asset register and process depreciation
- Support stock accounting, reconciliations and adjustments
- Prepare and submit VAT returns and assist with wider compliance requirements
- Assist with budgeting, forecasting and multi-company reporting
- Contribute to year-end audit preparation and respond to auditor queries

For immediate review, contact Niall Cooper at 3 Point Recruitment

Applications can be made via this advert or directly on our website!

title: Part Time Website Content Coordinator
description:
Website Content Coordinator

Location: Coventry CV4 and home working

Salary: £17,000 to £18,900 pro rata actual (Up to £33,000 FTE)

Hours: Part-time, 20 hours per week flexible

Contract: 9-month fixed-term contract

Benefits: Excellent holiday entitlement, contributory pension scheme, onsite parking and employee assistance programme

We are working on behalf of esteemed organisation, who are recruiting a creative and user-focused Website Content Coordinator to support one of the organisation's most significant digital transformation projects. This is an exciting opportunity to play a leading role in reviewing, rewriting and creating engaging website content that ensures their audience can find information quickly, access services easily and connect with everything the organisation has to offer.

As Website Content Coordinator, you will work in a small Communications & Marketing team, reporting into the Communications & Marketing Coordinator and working closely with the Communications & Marketing Director. You will also collaborate with colleagues across the organisation and the website project team to ensure content is clear, accessible, accurate and aligned with user needs, research insights and Warwick SU's brand.

The role is part-time at 20 hours per week. There are no fixed working days: the employer is happy to be flexible depending on the successful candidate and their needs, including considering shorter working days across the week. The business has a hybrid working policy with flexibility to work from home dependent on operational requirements.

This is a 9-month fixed-term contract based on the budget currently available for this project role.

Role and responsibilities:
- As a Website Content Coordinator, you will lead the audit, review and redevelopment of website content across the organisation, ensuring content is relevant, engaging and meets user needs.
- Write, edit and proofread high-quality website copy that reflects the organisations tone of voice, brand values and accessibility standards.
- Work closely with colleagues across the organisation to gather information, understand services and translate complex information into clear, student-friendly content.
- Apply user research, content strategy and digital best practice to improve website usability, navigation and overall user experience.
- Collaborate with the website project team to ensure content aligns with the new website structure, design, user journeys and project milestones.
- Support content migration, quality assurance and population of the new website using the content management system.
- Contribute to content governance processes, editorial standards and sustainable workflows that support long-term website maintenance.
- Build positive relationships across departments and help ensure website content remains accurate, relevant and up to date.

Skills and experience required:
- Demonstrable experience writing, editing and proofreading content for websites or other digital channels.
- Experience managing complex content projects involving multiple stakeholders.
- Experience gathering information from subject matter experts and translating it into engaging content for target audiences.
- Experience reviewing and improving content for usability, readability and accessibility.
- Exceptional written communication and copywriting skills, with excellent attention to detail.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing deadlines.
- Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to work collaboratively across an organisation.
- Understanding of digital content best practice, including accessibility and user-centred content design.
- Proactive, self-motivated and able to work independently, with a curious and analytical approach to understanding user needs.
- Experience of website redevelopment or digital transformation projects and familiarity with content management systems would be advantageous.

Benefits:
- Pro rota holiday entitlement based on 22 days annual leave including Bank Holidays and additional closure days
- Enhanced pension scheme
- Wellbeing programme
- Onsite parking
- BUPA cash plan
- Employee assistance programme

Interviews are scheduled for week commencing 21st and 28th September 2026.

If you are looking for a creative digital content role where you can make an impact, then please apply for this Website Content Coordinator opportunity.

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
Job Title: Payroll Administrator

Salary: Up to £35,000

Location: Coventry

Hours: Full-time, 37 hours per week

Working: Office-based

The Opportunity

An excellent opportunity for an experienced bureau or accountancy
practice payroll professional looking to develop beyond
traditional payroll processing and progress towards a more
Payroll Adviser-focused role.

You'll take greater ownership of client relationships, act as a
trusted point of contact and play an active role in delivering an
exceptional service.

The business is also embracing AI, automation and new technology,
making this an opportunity for someone who wants to develop with
the future of payroll.

Key Responsibilities

Process end-to-end payrolls across a portfolio of clients.
Manage client queries and act as a key point of contact.
Build strong client relationships and provide payroll guidance.
Complete payroll checks and audits to ensure accuracy and
compliance.
Support the Senior Payroll Manager with workload allocation and
team development.
Train and mentor junior team members where required.
Maintain accurate client records and payroll documentation.
Ensure payrolls are delivered accurately and within agreed
deadlines.
Keep up to date with UK payroll legislation and statutory
requirements.

About You

Strong bureau or accountancy practice payroll experience.
Good knowledge of UK payroll legislation, PAYE, statutory
payments, pensions and auto-enrolment.
Confident managing multiple clients and competing deadlines.
Strong communication and client relationship skills.
Commercially minded, proactive and solutions-focused.
Ambitious to develop beyond payroll processing.
Staffology experience advantageous, but not essential.

Please contact or apply to this
advert to be considered.

JGA Recruitment Group Ltd ("We") are committed to equality of
opportunity for all applications regardless of age, disability,
, gender reassignment, sexual orientation, pregnancy and
maternity, race, religion or belief and marriage and civil
partnerships. We are also committed to protecting and respecting
your privacy. We are a specialist Payroll and HR recruitment
agency and recruitment business defined in the Employment
Agencies and Employment Businesses Regulations 2003 (our
business). These statements, together with our privacy notices,
set out the basis on which any personal data we collect from you
or that you provide to us will be processed by us.

title: Ward Clerk
company: University Hospitals Coventry and Warwickshire NHS Trust
advertiser_name: University Hospitals Coventry and Warwickshire NHS Trust
description: We have an exciting opportunity available for a Ward Clerk to join our Team here at UHCW. The post holder will be joining our Performance & Informatics (P&I) department who are well respected and the largest of our corporate services. The P&I portfolio encompasses Business Intelligence &Informatics, Information Systems Development, Clinical Coding, Data Quality and Patient Access. P&I work cross functionally to support the Trusts operational delivery of both national and internal targets which ensures the highest standards of patient care are delivered. A robust Performance Management Framework is embedded across UHCW that tracks and evaluates progress and supports both operational and clinical governance frameworks. New opportunities at a nationallevel are being developed by P&I in areas of health inequality, waiting list management and system working. As a Ward Clerk you will be expected to: Act as the first point of contact for dealing with routine enquiries and take action as necessary liaising with others as appropriate. This includes reception cover duties during working hours. Communicate with staff, patients and/or external organisations using appropriate methods. Please be advised that sponsorship is not eligible for this post. Maintain both manual and electronic filing systems and databases, as required by the department and Trust policies, ensuring all documents are accurately and appropriately archived. Maintain an efficient and comprehensive administrative service, including photocopying, providing support to the departments and other team members as requested. Utilise relevant Trust EPR systems, as determined by the role, ensure all relevant patient data is collected and input accurately in line with Trust guidelines. Collate, input and monitor department documentation and information to assist with the production of monthly reports for the department. Responsible for the dissemination of all relevant information to departments, external and internal users (e.g. dissemination of minutes, memos). Assist with training new team members in Trust operational systems and department procedures. Responsible for ordering stationery and other equipment whilst monitoring and maintaining stock levels using GHX system. Responsible for the receipt and distribution of incoming/outgoing post and action accordingly. Prioritise daily tasks to achieve timescales set. Act as first point of contact for complaints within the department, dealing with them accordingly and in line with Trust policy and values and departmental standards. Provide appropriate cover in the absence of other members of the team. Continually contribute to patient and business improvement Agendas. Share ideas for potential service improvement. For further details please see the attached job description.
